scheme_name: Exposure Visits To The Assam Legislative Assembly
other_conditions: Students must be enrolled in High/Higher Secondary Schools or colleges in Assam.
Students should be studying Arts/Humanities subjects such as Political Science, Economics, or social sciences.
Selection is based on good academic performance and active participation in extracurricular activities like debates, mock parliament, etc.
Batch size must not exceed 50 students.
Participation is voluntary; only willing students should be selected.
benefits_summary: Provides students practical exposure to the legislative process and opportunities to interact with state officials.
